intro: Documentary photography from assignments and personal work across Bangladesh — rivers, streets, and the people living alongside both.

items.title: A Bangladesh flag on a bamboo pole in front of a brick-kiln chimney trailing smoke across a grey sky
items.caption: The flag and the kiln, sharing the same sky.

items.title: Aerial view of a tin-roofed house submerged to the eaves in floodwater, a wooden boat moored alongside
items.caption: Floodwater up to the eaves. The boat tied alongside is the way in and the way out.

items.title: A man in a black T-shirt raises his hand among a crowd of people dressed in black on a Dhaka street
items.caption: Hands up in the crowd.

items.title: A wooden plank gangway leaning against the freshly painted blue and yellow hull of a river launch
items.caption: A plank and a repainted hull — the way aboard.

items.title: Aerial view of a lake threading between densely built blocks of Dhaka, high-rises on the horizon
items.caption: Water still cuts a line through the density, from the air.

items.title: A woman seated on a pavement at night with two small children in bright clothes
items.caption: A mother and her two children on the footpath after dark.

items.title: Three men working waist-deep in a pale river beside a small boat, a woman and child in silhouette in the foreground
items.caption: A woman and child watch the fishers work the shallows.

items.title: Overhead view of three wooden boats moored against a silted, eroding riverbank beside a concrete-block revetment
items.caption: Concrete blocks hold one stretch of bank. The silt beside them is going.

items.title: Aerial view of sunlight scattering across a river channel, a single boat pulled up on the sandbar
items.caption: One boat on the sandbar, where the water has dropped back.

items.title: Two wooden country boats moored on still water at sunrise, the sky mirrored around them
items.caption: Still water doubling the sky.

items.title: Two wooden boats in a narrow channel almost closed over by water hyacinth and overhanging trees
items.caption: A channel water hyacinth has nearly closed.

items.title: A cyclist silhouetted on an embankment against a deep blue sky, eucalyptus trees on either side
items.caption: Last light on the embankment road.
